classifications.rationale: This recital only describes statutory duties and authorities; it does not itself direct an executive actor or change any legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: Section 504(c) requires the President to issue regulations to implement the provisions of section 504.

classifications.rationale: The President makes a preparatory determination to delegate specified functions to the Secretary; the segment does not itself alter private legal rights.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that it is appropriate to authorize the Secretary of Commerce (Secretary) to perform certain functions

classifications.rationale: The President makes an internal-management determination concerning authorization of the USTR, while the remaining text merely recites statutory authority.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that it is appropriate to authorize the United States Trade Representative (USTR) to perform certain functions specified in section 504(a) of the Act.

classifications.rationale: The President determines that a country-name designation should be modified, but this segment does not itself make the operative HTS modification.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that the designation of Western Samoa as a beneficiary developing country under the GSP should be modified

classifications.rationale: The President makes a preparatory eligibility determination that designation would be appropriate; the operative designation occurs elsewhere.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that it is appropriate to designate Samoa as a least-developed beneficiary developing country for purposes of the GSP.

classifications.rationale: The President determines that restoration of GSP treatment is appropriate, but this segment does not itself restore that treatment or modify the HTS.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that it is appropriate to restore GSP treatment for these articles

classifications.rationale: The President presently modifies the HTS to establish separate tariff treatment and conforming tariff categories; any later administration is implementation of that current legal act.
classifications.evidence: the HTS is modified as provided in section A of the Annex to this proclamation.

classifications.rationale: The provision assigns the Secretary authority to consider annual modification requests, without dictating that any import limitation be changed.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary is authorized to exercise the authority set forth in section 504(b)(1) of the Act to consider, on an annual basis, requests

classifications.rationale: The provision authorizes the Secretary to assess possible quota modifications and recommend them to the President, leaving the legal outcome undecided.
classifications.evidence: whether the limitation on the quantity of imports of worsted wool fabrics under headings 9902.51.11 and 9902.51.12 of the HTS should be modified

classifications.rationale: The provision delegates regulatory authority to the Secretary but does not prescribe a particular binding regulatory result.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary is authorized to issue regulations to implement the provisions of sections 501 and 504(b) of the Act

classifications.rationale: This single segment inseparably combines internal monitoring and supersession provisions with present HTS modifications, a country eligibility designation, restored tariff treatment, and an effective-date rule.
classifications.evidence: Samoa is designated as a least-developed beneficiary developing country for purposes of the GSP and title V of the 1974 Act.
